metadata.dcterms:title: Markov traces on degenerate cyclotomic Hecke algebras
metadata.dcterms:creator: ZHAO, DEKE
metadata.dcterms:abstract: Let Hn(u) be the degenerate cyclotomic Hecke algebra with parameter u = {u1, . . . , um}. The paper aims to define and construct the (non-)normalized Markov traces on the sequence {Hn(u)}∞ n=1. This allows us to provide the Brou´e–Malle–Michel symmetrizing trace on Hn(u) and show that the Brundan–Kleshchev trace is a specialization of the non-normalized Markov traces on Hn(u).
